subject: eng
title: Our favourite games: we / our, they / their
goal: Ти вивчиш назви ігор і навчишся використовувати займенники we / our, they / their, розповідаючи про улюблені ігри.

theory.text: Сьогодні ти дізнаєшся назви ігор і навчишся казати не тільки «мій» чи «твій», а й «наш» (our) та «їхній» (their) — коли говориш про групу людей.

items.ex: We play a board game every Sunday.
We play hide-and-seek in the garden.
We need a dice for this game.

theory.title: our, their
theory.text: Присвійні займенники показують, кому щось належить: **my** (мій), **your** (твій), **his** (його), **her** (її), **our** (наш), **their** (їхній). We play chess. **Our** favourite game is chess. They like hide-and-seek. **Their** favourite game is hide-and-seek.

lines.text: My favourite game is chess. What about you and Sam?
Our favourite game is hide-and-seek! We play it every day.
What about Andriy and Max? What's their favourite game?
Their favourite game is video games. They play together every evening.
I like board games too. Let's play cards!

theory.text: Не плутай **our** (наш) і **their** (їхній): our — коли говоримо про себе (ми), their — коли говоримо про інших (вони).

exercises.text: We like chess. {Our} favourite game is chess. They like video games. {Their} favourite game is video games.

exercises.q: Прочитай діалог ще раз. Так чи ні?

items.text: Kate: "Their favourite game is board games."

exercises.text: Our favourite game is chess. Their favourite game is hide-and-seek. We play it every day.

homework.text: Sam and Kate like hide-and-seek. {Their} favourite game is hide-and-seek. We like puzzles. {Our} favourite game is puzzles.

homework.q: Обери правильний варіант: «Наша команда грає в шахи».
Напиши 4-5 речень про улюблені ігри твоєї родини або друзів, використай our/their.
homework.sample: Our favourite game is chess. My brother and I play it every evening. My friends like video games. Their favourite game is a football game. We also like board games.

homework.text: Our favourite game is chess. My friends like video games. Their favourite game is fun.

reflection: У яку гру любить грати твоя родина?
